description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory responsible for creating, managing, and caching language objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for loading language data, handling fallbacks, and generating language objects based on language codes, primarily supporting localization features in HTMLPurifier.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing localized language objects, including cache management and fallback logic.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the LanguageFactory instance; optionally resets or sets a prototype.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the factory, including validator and directory setup.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a language object for a given code, managing fallbacks if necessary.

methods.name: getFallbackFor
methods.description: Returns the fallback language code for a given language.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language data into cache, including handling language file inclusion and fallback merging.
